notes.title: Summer Style Pack Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34833252/a09d89da5a8e1612d0f4efb4e10f7ee4fa725264.png[/img]
Help your 3D custom ladies beat the heat with the Summer Style Pack, available now with a limited-time launch discount of 20% off!

This content DLC adds a total of 14 new summer-themed clothing items and one new accessory. Check out the details on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1096890/3D_Custom_Lady_Maker__Summer_Style_Pack/]store page[/url]!

notes.title: Free content update available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34833252/bc99282a5b506a344cc10090af5a8cdc96de45cd.png[/img]
The first free content update for 3D Custom Lady Maker is available now!

[h1]New Customization Options[/h1]

[b]T-Shirt[/b] (Top)
An ordinary t-shirt. Is it hers or one of yours...?

[b]Denim Shorts[/b] (Bottom)
Why so formal? Short shorts for the summer heat.

[b]Gym Shirt[/b] (Top)
A tight-fitting gym top. For sporty types.

[b]Gym Shorts[/b] (Bottom)
A tight-fitting pair of gym shorts. Easy to move in.

[b]Kiss[/b] (Paint)
Now how did that get there? A flirty kiss-mark face decal.

[b]Star[/b] (Paint)
A cheerful face decal.

[h1]System Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now customize the colors of the Heart Earring and Sunglasses accessories.
[*]You can now apply up to three Paint items simultaneously.
[*]The names of several items have been adjusted to be more natural.
[/list]
That's all for now. Stay tuned for the Summer Style Pack DLC, coming very soon and launching with a limited-time 20% discount!

Happy 3D custom lady making!

Now you can customize your profile with 3D ladies!

notes.title: Modding Tools available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are pleased to announce the official release of the Modding Tools for 3D Custom Lady Maker!
They are located in a new sub-directory of the game's install directory, [i]3DCustomLadyMaker_ModdingTools[/i].

The tools are in the form of a Unity assets package, so please be advised that they do require some knowledge of Unity and/or 3D modeling to develop. For a basic introduction to the modding tools please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1721145186]Modding Basics[/url] guide.

To apply a mod, simply drop it into the [i]3DCustomLadyMaker_Data/Mod/[/i] directory and play!

We are still looking into the possibility of implementing Workshop support directly but for now, users are welcome to make mods for their own use or to share through other channels.

[u]Finally, in unrelated news...[/u]
[list]
   [*]We are working on adding Steam trading cards! These should release sooner, within the next two weeks.
   [*]We are actively working to add more content to the game. We do not want to be too precise with dates before things are ready, but you can expect both a free content update and a paid content DLC fairly soon!
[/list]
We try to read every piece of feedback our users give us, so we know there is demand for more content, and we're working to meet that demand.
Do you have any specific requests for future updates, such as costumes, hairstyles, or gameplay features? Please leave us a comment below!

notes.title: 3D Custom Lady Maker & 18+ DLC released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Sorry to have kept you waiting. 3D Custom Lady Maker has just released, alongside its 18+ DLC!

It's a little earlier than the original planned timing of Golden Week, but as some members of the team will be unable to deal with issues during that vacation period in Japan, we thought it best to go forth boldly.

We'll be around this coming week to help answer any questions and resolve any issues that players have with the game!

We hope you enjoy it!
